task_adjustments: Keep the source 3.608827058 kg empty tool case supported on a bench or the cart for core kitting/rework; no loaded single-arm carry requirement until robot payload and grasp are validated.
Treat the 3.19966 kg master cylinder as a cart-delivered or supported service workpiece initially; do not lower its mass to enable carrying.
Deep blue crate mass is 2.8367376 kg empty. Use it for supported stock storage or verified cart cargo, not an assumed single-arm lifting task.

The 0.41487625 kg small tray, 0.13533968 kg pulley, 0.07230999 kg spark plug, 0.0066213747 kg bracket and 0.010707934 kg bolt are the first geometry/grasp candidates; tiny/flat contact features still need evidence.
Keep all source body masses and mobility, including tool-chest and cart wheels; do not weld them to ground to make drawer or transport tasks easier.

checks_before_scene_placement.check: Decode each original GLB once; preserve original mesh triangles, transforms, material factors and basecolor/normal/metallic-roughness maps. Return a labeled thumbnail and dimensions for author review. A smooth generic replacement mesh is not acceptable.

Map every source motion body, fixed attachment and hinge/slide with source parent, frame, axis and limits. Compare decoded world-space geometry at reset to source bounds; verify no node transform is applied twice.

Measure blue/white crate, tray, tool-case and all candidate drawer interior bottoms, walls, openings and closure volumes using source meshes. Return source triangle/collision overlays or sections. A single convex hull filling the cavity cannot support containment tasks.

If source convexHull fills useful empty space, propose a source-triangle-preserving segmented/decomposed contact representation with measured clearance error; keep source visual mesh intact. Return proposal to Astra before choosing geometry cuts, tolerances or allowed contact exclusions.

Measure actual handle aperture, grasp thickness and approach clearance for case/chest/cart/tools/parts against the selected robot gripper; identify rigid roots and supports. Do not infer a usable handle from the asset name.

Inspect source drawer, lid, latch, pliers, caliper, wheel/caster and vise motion through original limits in geometry-only poses. Preserve raw source. Return conflicting sweeps; no automatic source pose repair.

After authored contact adaptation and placement: native settling, contact, drawer/lid sweep and load support. Cart pushing and clamp retention require separate measured demonstrations; joint existence alone is insufficient.

visual_review_order: blue crate, white crate and small tray
pulley, spark plug, bracket, bolt and master cylinder
resource_scope: One asset preview at a time; no native physics, policy or large conversion sweep requested by this decision. Start with source rendering and analytical geometry evidence.
